title: Sprint 3: Capture from existing structure (bwrk template capture)
description: Implement bwrk template capture <work-ref> --out <file>: snapshots an existing epic/milestone subtree (kinds, titles, descriptions, labels, acceptance, gates, dependency edges) into a valid template YAML file, prompting/flagging which concrete values become {{var}} placeholders. Output must pass bwrk template validate.
acceptanceCriteria: capture of a hand-built structure produces a template file that passes validate
Round-trip: capture then run reproduces an equivalent structure (new IDs, same shape)
Sprint closed with git checkpoint commit(s) or a no-commit reason code
